decisions.reason: After only one year the product's market potential is still uncertain, and as a niche machinery option with only limited visible commitment on the website it is worth keeping but has a moderate risk of withdrawal if demand stays weak.

A dedicated product page suggests a stronger initial commitment and lower immediate likelihood of abandonment, so the firm would likely keep this option open while learning more about customer uptake.

Because it is only briefly mentioned and appears to be a more peripheral extension, management would keep it for now under uncertainty but it faces a somewhat higher chance of being dropped if it does not reveal clear value soon.

Its dedicated page indicates meaningful strategic intent, and with uncertainty still unresolved after launch the firm would likely retain it as an option unless early commercial feedback turns clearly negative.
